description: AgentShield synthetic policy bundle for corp.example (deterministic Python engine; OPA-replaceable).

hard_rules.H1: verified IAM decision DENY for the pending operation
hard_rules.H2: RESTRICTED data (stored or provenance-derived) to any destination outside corp.example
hard_rules.H3: CONFIDENTIAL or RESTRICTED data to a personal or blocklisted destination
hard_rules.P1: data label above the destination's approved level, and no approval policy covers it

hold_rules.H5: the destination is not approved for this label; only the data owner can grant a scoped, single-use exception

mandatory_analyzer_rules.reason: egress of material derived from board minutes needs a derivation review

lineage_gap_rule.description: a derived artifact with at most one untracked input keeps the label UNKNOWN; a clean derivation review or semantic DLP finding lets it be treated at its highest known source label. A clean finding never sets a permission.

audit_rules.A2: an audit-only egress where a mandatory pre-egress analyzer never ran -> CREATE_REVIEW_CASE plus an advisory RECOMMEND_POLICY_CHANGE
